description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAC UX / Reporting Developer based in India. 

 We are looking for an experienced SAC UX / Reporting Developer to design and deliver intuitive, high-performance analytical applications and reporting solutions within complex SAP environments. In this role, you will transform business requirements into interactive dashboards, advanced visualizations, and user-friendly reporting experiences that support strategic decision-making. You will work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless data integration and reliable reporting capabilities. The position combines strong technical expertise in SAP Analytics Cloud with a focus on UX design, application development, and performance optimization. You will contribute to complex transformation projects while collaborating with international teams and business users. This is an opportunity to take ownership of impactful analytics solutions and help organizations unlock greater value from their enterprise data.

Accountabilities:
 
 As a SAC UX / Reporting Developer, you will lead the design, development, and optimization of analytical applications and reporting solutions, ensuring they meet business requirements while delivering an intuitive user experience. You will collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to translate reporting needs into scalable, reliable, and high-performing applications.


 
 Design, develop, and maintain SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Stories, interactive dashboards, analytical applications, and reporting interfaces.



 
 Create intuitive reporting solutions using SAC visualization capabilities, advanced design features, and UX best practices.



 
 Develop interactive components, including charts, tables, filters, input controls, and navigation functionalities.



 
 Implement custom application logic and interactive features using SAC scripting and JavaScript where required.



 
 Design and optimize reporting models, calculated measures, dimensions, and KPIs to support complex business requirements.



 
 Integrate SAC reporting solutions with SAP Datasphere, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, and other enterprise data sources.



 
 Gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into functional dashboards and analytical applications.



 
 Optimize dashboard performance, visualization efficiency, and overall user experience across different reporting scenarios.



 
 Troubleshoot reporting issues, validate data accuracy, and ensure consistency between source systems and SAC applications.



 
 Support testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), technical documentation, deployment, and continuous improvement initiatives.




 Requirements: 

 The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience in SAP Analytics Cloud development, particularly in reporting, dashboard creation, and advanced data visualization. You should combine technical expertise with a solid understanding of analytical data structures and UX principles, alongside the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.


 
 Proven experience developing SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Stories, interactive dashboards, analytical applications, and reporting solutions.



 
 Strong knowledge of SAC visualization capabilities, calculated measures, dimensions, filters, and input controls.



 
 Hands-on experience with SAC application scripting, JavaScript, and advanced interactive reporting functionalities.



 
 Solid understanding of UI/UX design principles, dashboard usability, and data visualization best practices.



 
 Experience integrating SAC with SAP Datasphere, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, or other enterprise data platforms.



 
 Good understanding of analytical data modeling, reporting structures, KPIs, and business intelligence concepts.



 
 Experience optimizing SAC dashboard performance, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring reporting accuracy.



 
 Familiarity with SAP Datasphere data models, semantic layers, and analytical datasets is an advantage.



 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with excellent communication and collaboration skills.



 
 Ability to work effectively with solution architects, functional consultants, and business stakeholders.




 Benefits: 


 
 Competitive compensation: Attractive salary and benefits package within a supportive professional environment.



 
 Professional development: CHF 1,500 annual learning and development budget (approximately JPY 280,000).



 
 Continuous learning: Access to optional in-house workshops, academies, and training opportunities.



 
 Remote flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere in Japan, subject to client project requirements.



 
 Global work flexibility: Enjoy up to 25 days working from a preferred global location, subject to client approval.



 
 Annual leave: Up to 20 days of annual vacation, depending on seniority.



 
 Work-life balance: Flexible time-off arrangements to support personal well-being and recovery.



 
 Collaborative culture: Work alongside international talent in a diverse, supportive, and team-oriented environment.



 
 Flat hierarchies: Benefit from direct communication, autonomy, and close mentoring from senior leaders.



 
 Team integration: Access to a dedicated budget for team activities, collaboration, and relationship-building.



 
 Birthday recognition: Receive a special gift on your birthday.



 
 Anniversary rewards: Receive substantial bonuses for key employment milestones at 5, 10, and 15 years.



 
 Performance bonus: Eligibility for a 10% annual performance bonus based on company KPIs.



 
 Referral rewards: Access to bonuses when successfully referring new talent, for positions up to Director level.



 
 Work environment: Access to a temporary office in Shinbashi, as well as client or project-site locations when required.
